name: Flameguard
summary: Protective magic becomes a burning ward that converts punishment into Heat.

name: Flameweaver
summary: Arcane fire is shaped around allies and converted into layered spell effects.

name: Nightblade
summary: Shadow magic is woven into weapon attacks and movement.

name: Umbral Bastion
summary: Shields become living darkness that punishes attackers and protects allies.

name: Storm Conduit
summary: Barriers conduct lightning between protected allies and enemies.

name: Frostwarden
summary: Defensive magic freezes attackers and creates zones of control.

name: Blood Martyr
summary: Healing is converted into controlled self-sacrifice and blood power.

name: Voidcaller
summary: Void magic tears openings that distort movement and spell range.

name: Spiritwarden
summary: Spirit allies intercept attacks and empower healing and control.

name: Ironbreaker
summary: Ironblood endurance turns defense into crushing counterattacks.

name: Wildfire Druid
summary: Primal transformation carries living flame through beasts and terrain.

name: Ash Ravager
summary: Rage feeds on Heat until the warrior erupts in destructive flame.

name: Dawnkeeper
summary: Holy power creates radiant barriers and punishes cursed foes.

name: Bloodfire Ascendant
summary: Blood and flame combine into volatile power that rewards controlled risk.

name: Shadowfire Adept
summary: Flame burns through darkness, producing delayed eruptions from hidden attacks.

name: Stormblade
summary: Lightning is stored in weapon strikes and released through movement.

name: Frostmage
summary: Cold magic creates escalating control zones around affected targets.

name: Beastwarden
summary: Wildblood bonds turn summoned or transformed creatures into tactical partners.

name: Void Assassin
summary: Void steps make attacks appear from impossible angles.

name: Spirit Monk
summary: Martial techniques channel ancestral spirits through movement and defense.

name: Holy Flame
summary: Radiant and fire magic combine into cleansing flame.

name: Iron Rage
summary: Ironblood resilience lets rage convert absorbed damage into momentum.

name: Shadow Chorus
summary: Performance magic creates illusions that act as coordinated shadows.

name: Frostfang
summary: Ranger attacks accumulate Frostbite and eventually immobilize prey.
